note: How many repositories have a CODEOWNERS file (Present) versus none (Missing). Which repositories are missing one is in the table below.
methodology: Check each repository for a CODEOWNERS file in the standard locations (root, .github/, or docs/).
Resolve duplicates presence-wins: if any check for a repository found a file, the repository counts as having one.
Count repositories by that answer — present versus missing — across the organisation.
population: Repositories with or without a CODEOWNERS file in the standard GitHub locations.
